lines: Jesus i wonderful and He is mine!
Jesus is wonderful He is my King;
Jesus is wonderful - Of Him I Sing!
Jesus is wonderful! Blessings, I know,
Along my daily path He doth bestow.
Jesus is wonderful, Jesus is mine -
He is the One that I love;
He is my Lord and King, Savior divine -
He is the One that I love;
Blessings, I know, He doth bestow -
Jesus is wonderful, Jesus i mine, -
He is the one that I love.
